label: POTENCY_1 or a distinct CAUSE_2 for contingents, from power grounding
meaning: Answers #1870's remaining gap 1 conditionally. A contingent being is corruptible simply, hence in POTENCY_1 in some respect, or under some power over its esse; correlation makes it corruptible or makes the power's holder a CAUSE_2 of its esse, distinct by no-self-esse-cause. This is the q.9 a.2 two-channel reading of B2 or B4: PGP plays bridge (i) (contingency gives mutability in the subject or through a power) at the respect of being, and correlation plays bridge (ii) restricted to beings incorruptible simply; the unrestricted bridge (ii) fails for corruption by another (controls, corruptor).
